reference_exchange_rate.limitations: Mid-market/historical reference only. Excludes bank spread, hedging, FX timing, freight, insurance, duties, VAT recovery treatment and supplier payment terms.

sources.what_it_supports: Global high-volume BEV pack-price reference for scale sanity checks.
sources.must_not_infer: Not a South African landed quote, a price for a specific cell/chemistry/voltage/design, an early-stage OEM price, or a guaranteed 2026 price.

sources.what_it_supports: Cross-segment LFP market context; BEV-specific $99/kWh is the primary anchor for this passenger-EV comparison.
sources.must_not_infer: Must not substitute the all-segment mean for an automotive pack quote; stationary storage requirements and purchase terms differ.

sources.what_it_supports: Transparent arithmetic for translating global USD reference points into approximate ZAR values.
sources.must_not_infer: Not a supplier FX rate, hedge, transfer rate, landed component price or future exchange-rate forecast.

sources.what_it_supports: Public South African entry-price reference; freeze variant, standard equipment, warranty, delivery charges, VAT boundary and date before any like-for-like comparison.
sources.must_not_infer: Not an OEM manufacturing cost, supplier quote or permanent price.

sources.what_it_supports: Like-for-like performance, mass, charging and consumable comparison.
sources.must_not_infer: The two variants and two drive cycles are not interchangeable. These are manufacturer published values, not independent test results.

sources.what_it_supports: South African consumer replacement-price range for the published 185/55 R16 size; current range spans budget through premium products.
sources.must_not_infer: Not an OEM wholesale price, tyre equivalence, rolling-resistance comparison, wet-braking result or fitment-included price.

sources.what_it_supports: Approximate consumer fitting/balancing envelope for installed-replacement sensitivity.
sources.must_not_infer: Not an OEM tyre assembly cost or a binding service quotation; wheel alignment is additional and varies.

sources.what_it_supports: An observable public price for a high-power aftermarket conversion kit, useful as an explicit exclusion/contrast.
sources.must_not_infer: Not an OEM unit cost, not sized for a 55 kW compact car, not a complete production-ready vehicle drive module and not an appropriate direct BOM benchmark. Custom mounts, axles and cooling are still application-specific.

sources.what_it_supports: An example of published compact axial-flux motor power-density/efficiency envelope for trade-space comparison.
sources.must_not_infer: Not a mass-market price, not proof that peak efficiency is achieved over a drive cycle, not an integrated motor-inverter price and not evidence it is cheaper than a volume-produced e-axle.

sources.description: Other vehicles with only electric motor for propulsion
sources.what_it_supports: Import-vs-local-production scenario boundary for the relevant finished-vehicle tariff line.
sources.must_not_infer: Do not apply automatically without confirming classification, origin rules, preference eligibility, customs value, other charges and current amendments.

sources.what_it_supports: A published customs-duty scenario for goods correctly classified under 8507.60.
sources.must_not_infer: Zero customs duty does not mean no VAT, freight, insurance, port costs, compliance requirements or classification risk.

reported_points.policy_signal: phase out policy support for existing SKD operations and no support for new SKD facilities; tighten CKD definition

sources.what_it_supports: Add deep-local-content and CKD-vs-SKD scenarios to the manufacturing strategy instead of assuming imported near-complete kits remain the cheapest policy-supported route.
sources.must_not_infer: A news report of an announcement is not a complete enacted rulebook; implementation, timing, definitions and incentive eligibility need the official final instruments.

sources.what_it_supports: Pack architecture and disassembly design can materially change end-of-life labor/cost in the studied sample.
sources.must_not_infer: Not a universal 75% saving available to our vehicle; the paper compared six specific production packs and its results are design/context dependent.

claim_ceiling: This ledger preserves public, published observations and arithmetic derivatives. It is not a set of procurement quotations, supplier commitments, an audited bill of materials, confirmation of local manufacturing incentives or a vehicle safety/engineering qualification.
